result.title: Beyond ICD Codes: Semantic IDs for Generative Medical Coding
result.summary: Generative approaches to automatic International Classification of Diseases (ICD) coding use large language models (LLMs) to predict ICD codes from clinical documents. However, original ICD code strings are not ideal generation targets because the ICD hierarchy does not always reflect clinical relationships, and LLMs struggle to interpret and generate these codes. We introduce SemICD, a framework that trains LLMs to generate Semantic IDs (SIDs) instead. SemICD constructs SIDs by hierarchically clustering embeddings of textual code profiles, allowing semantically related codes to share prefixes while each complete SID uniquely identifies one ICD code. To align the SID tokens with clinical semantics, we employ two auxiliary tasks for bidirectional generation between textual code profiles and SIDs. Experiments on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV with four LLMs show that SemICD outperforms direct code generation, improving Micro-F1 by 1.34-8.00 points. Our code is available at https://github.com/youwillbethebest/SemICD.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 SemICD，用 LLM 生成按层次聚类构建的语义 ID（SID）代替原始 ICD 编码来完成自动医学编码，并用编码文本档案与 SID 之间的双向生成辅助任务对齐语义，在 MIMIC-III/IV 上取得 F1 提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作通过层次聚类嵌入构造共享前缀的离散语义 ID，并用双向生成任务为其提供语义监督，这一「结构化离散 token 构造 + 对齐监督」思路可供核查如何设计 LVR 中分层、可解释的 latent token 及其训练信号；属纯文本医疗应用，与视觉推理主线无直接关系。
